name: sdd
description: Claude Code plugins by nadiar: workflow skills (/specify, /refine, /board, /solve, /validate, /orchestrate), a multi-axis code reviewer, and context-writing helpers.

plugins.name: sdd
plugins.description: A bd-backed, parallel-capable workflow: /specify authors stories/epics in Beads, /refine revises a story, /board shows the backlog, /solve implements one in an isolated worktree, /validate merges after human review, /orchestrate automates the solve-review-land loop for a whole epic behind one final PR. Requires the bd (Beads) CLI.

plugins.name: code-review-quality
plugins.description: Multi-axis code review before merge — correctness, readability, architecture, security, performance — reported as severity-labelled findings and a verdict. Reviews the working diff by default, or a commit, branch, tag, path, or PR. --effort sets depth; --fix applies the fixes in place and leaves them uncommitted. Any model tier; no dependencies.

plugins.name: writing-claude-md
plugins.description: Skill for creating and updating CLAUDE.md and other LLM project context files. Teaches what to include, what to omit, and how to keep context lean.
